name: for-gosub
source:
10 ON ERROR REPORT:PRINT:PRINT "LOOP_REF_END_0":OSCLI "BYE"
20 PRINT "LOOP_REF_BEGIN_0"
30 FOR i%=1 TO 3:GOSUB 1000:NEXT:PRINT "done"
40 PRINT "LOOP_REF_END_0":OSCLI "BYE"
1000 PRINT ;i%:RETURN

name: repeat-return
source:
10 ON ERROR REPORT:PRINT:PRINT "LOOP_REF_END_1":OSCLI "BYE"
20 PRINT "LOOP_REF_BEGIN_1"
30 GOSUB 1000
40 PRINT "LOOP_REF_END_1":OSCLI "BYE"
1000 REPEAT:RETURN:UNTIL 1
